headline: Nvidia Names Colette Kress Interim CEO After Jensen Huang Resigns
deck: Nvidia announced an immediate leadership change, a search for a permanent chief executive and its first board chair.
body: Nvidia’s board said Jensen Huang had resigned as president, chief executive and a board member, effective immediately [E1].
Colette Kress, Nvidia’s executive vice president and chief financial officer, agreed to serve as interim chief executive [E2].
Kress will retain her executive vice president and chief financial officer roles while she is interim chief executive, until Nvidia names a permanent successor [E3].
The board said it had begun a search for a permanent chief executive and would consider internal and external candidates [E4].
Nvidia also appointed Harvey C. Jones as its first chair of the board [E5].
Jones said Kress had helped lead Nvidia through a period of growth and had a deep understanding of its business, customers, operations and financial position [E6].
Kress said she was committed to building on the foundation Huang created over 33 years with Nvidia’s leadership team [E7].
The Verge reported that the board’s announcement followed reports of two extramarital affairs involving Huang [E8].
The change since the paper’s 9 November coverage is the board’s announced resignation and interim succession [E1][E2].
